review.assessment: This change introduces a new `src/lib.rs` defining `split_bill` using plain integer division (`total_cents / people`). It does not fix the stated bug; remainders are silently discarded, so shares will sum to less than `total_cents`. The acceptance test passes only because it tests a perfectly divisible case (100 ÷ 4).

findings.defect: Integer division truncates the remainder instead of distributing it across shares. The returned vector sums to 102 instead of 103.
